actions.description: Stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting.

inputs.description: Accepted for the catalogue class; the 8742 ST command has no deceleration setting and this driver ignores it
inputs.name: deceleration

actions.name: stop_motion

facts.text: Controller.command sends a New Focus style command through the USB endpoints and returns a parsed reply only when the command contains '?'
parse_command builds '1><driver> <command> <parameter>\r' from the New Focus command text
The connection check queries QM? for motor channels 1 to 4
MOTOR_TYPE maps the QM? reply code 0 to 3 to a motor description
The joystick loop starts a move only when the MD? reply ends in 1
An axis is moved by writing its velocity with VA and then sending MV+ or MV-
The comment calls 2000 the maximal speed for the New Focus 8821-L motor
The terminal program sends ST before the control loop and stops one axis with <axis>ST
